description.zh: 个人 DSH 插件市场索引。

description.en: A sidebar panel of your saved command lines with comments. Click an entry to run it in a fresh DSH terminal tab; shell (PowerShell / CMD / bash) is detected automatically and can be pinned per entry. Commands sync to ~/.dsh/quick-cmd-runner/commands.json.
description.zh: 侧边栏常用命令行面板：保存带注释的命令，点击即在 DSH 终端新开标签执行；自动识别 PowerShell / CMD / bash，可按条固定。命令自动同步到 ~/.dsh/quick-cmd-runner/commands.json，记事本可直接编辑。
